0.headline: Business in the Week Ahead (October 12 – 16, 2026)
0.heading: Business in the Week Ahead (October 12 – 16, 2026)
0.intro: The upcoming week will be shaped by India’s CPI and WPI inflation data; US’ CPI inflation, industrial production output; UK’s GDP and industrial output; Eurozone area’s inflation and industrial production data
0.body:
Indian equity markets endured a volatile week, with persistent selling pressure pushing benchmark indices towards fresh lows. The benchmark index fell sharply on Thursday, slipping below the crucial 22,500 mark but on Friday, markets staged a rebound, recovering some losses as oil prices eased and buying interest returned.

However, as the Reserve Bank of India had announced a rate revision of 25 basis points and adopted a calibrated tightening stance, it has revived concerns of inflation and borrowing costs. Rising crude oil prices, elevated US bond yields and continued foreign investor outflows further weakened sentiment.

The market benchmark remains on course for a ninth consecutive weekly decline, with analysts expecting volatility and caution to persist. “Overall market sentiment remains cautiously optimistic for a recovery at the opening, although persistent FII outflows and elevated volatility continue to weigh on buying conviction,” said Hitesh Tailor, Technical Research Analyst at Choice Broking.

In IPO news, the IPO of HD Fire Protect Ltd will open for subscription on October 13 and close on October 15, 2026. The price band has been fixed at ₹258 to ₹271 per share, with a lot size of 55 shares.

Here are some important indicators that market participants should keep an eye out for.

Monday (October 12)

Earnings: HCL Tech, RBL Bank

India Inflation Rate: The headline inflation rate in India rose to 4.82% in August, from 4.45% in the previous month and aligned with market expectations of 4.8%. The September data will be shared.

Tuesday (October 13)

Earnings: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance

IPO: HD Fire Protect Ltd

Wednesday (October 14)

Earnings: BHEL, Ceat, ICICI Lombard, Tata Tech

India Wholesale Prices YoY: India’s wholesale prices increased 9.92% yoy in August, accelerating slightly from a 9.78% rise in July and surpassing expectations of 9.89%. September figures will be declared.

US Inflation Rate: The annual inflation rate in the US steadied at 3.4% in August, the same as in July and in line with forecasts. The September data will be announced.

Thursday (October 15)

Earnings: Cyient, HDFC AMC, HDFC Life, L&amp;T Finance, Karur Vysya, Nestle, Polycab, Tech Mahindra, Wipro

UK Monthly GDP YoY: The UK economy expanded 1.6% year-on-year in July, picking up from a 1.1% growth in June and beating expectations of a 1.2% expansion. The August GDP figures will be announced.

US Initial Jobless Claims: The number of Americans filing for unemployment benefits fell by 1,000 to 197,000 in the week ended September 26, below expectations of 200,000, according to the US Department of Labor. Numbers for week ending October 3 will be shared.

UK Industrial Production: Industrial Production in the United Kingdom increased 0.60 percent in July over the same month in the previous year. Data for August will be revealed.

UK Manufacturing Production: Manufacturing production in the UK increased by 2.6% year-on-year in July, above forecasts of 2% and accelerating from a 0.5% gain in the preceding period. The figures for August will be declared.

Friday (October 16)

Earnings: Bajaj Housing, CG Consumer, Federal Bank

Euro Area Inflation Rate: Eurozone annual inflation accelerated to 3.8% in September, up from 3.2% in August and above market expectations of 3.6%, according to preliminary estimates. The final data for September will be announced.

India Foreign Exchange Reserves: Foreign Exchange Reserves in India decreased to $747.56 billion in September 25 from 765.9 billion in the previous week. Numbers for week ending October 2 will be shared.

US Industrial Production: Industrial Production in the United States increased 1.40 percent in August over the same month in the previous year. Data for September will be announced.

US Manufacturing Production: Manufacturing Production in the United States increased 0.9% year-on-year in August 2026, following a 1.2% rise in July. Data for September will be declared.

Saturday (October 17)

Earnings: Axis Bank, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, India Cements, Yes Bank

1.headline: Fusion CX IPO: Rs 702-crore issue to open on October 14; check price band, GMP and key details
1.heading: Fusion CX IPO: Rs 702-crore issue to open on October 14; check price band, GMP and key details
1.intro: Fusion CX Ltd's initial public offering (IPO), worth Rs 702 crore, will open for subscription on October 14, 2026. The customer experience solutions provider has fixed the price band at Rs 275–289 per share.
1.body:
Fusion CX Ltd's initial public offering (IPO), worth Rs 702 crore, will open for subscription on October 14, 2026. The customer experience solutions provider has fixed the price band at Rs 275–289 per share.

The IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 500 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of 69.90 lakh shares aggregating Rs 202 crore. While the proceeds from the fresh issue will go to the company, the OFS will allow existing shareholders to sell part of their holdings.

Fusion CX has set the IPO price band at Rs 275–289 per share. The minimum application size for retail investors is 51 shares, translating into an investment of Rs 14,739 at the upper end of the price band.

Read Also: Denied US visa, he built Rs 26,000-crore company in India: How Amrit Acharya started Zetwerk with his IIT friends

The issue will open on October 14 and close on October 16, with allotment expected on October 19. The shares are scheduled to debut on the stock exchanges on October 22. Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd is the book-running lead manager, while KFin Technologies Ltd is the registrar to the issue.

In the grey market, the Fusion CX shares were commanding a premium of 14 percent over the IPO price on the morning of October 9, as per InvestorGain.

The GMP can fluctuate depending on market conditions, subscription trends and investor sentiment. It is not regulated by the stock exchanges and does not guarantee the listing price or returns.

Fusion CX plans to utilise part of the fresh issue proceeds to repay or prepay certain outstanding borrowings of the company and its subsidiaries, including select step-down subsidiaries.

The company also plans to invest in its step-down subsidiaries, Omind Technologies Inc. and Omind Technologies Private Limited, to upgrade information technology tools, including Arya and MindVoice.

Check IPO News Here

These investments are intended to support the company's technology capabilities and strengthen its operational infrastructure.

Fusion CX reported an improvement in its financial performance in FY26, with total income and profit increasing from the previous financial year.

Total income rose 37 percent to Rs 1,852 crore in FY26 from Rs 1,352 crore in FY25. Profit after tax (PAT) more than doubled to Rs 170 crore from Rs 74 crore, marking an increase of around 128 percent.

About Fusion CX Ltd

Incorporated in 2004, Fusion CX is a technology-driven customer experience (CX) solutions provider offering multilingual services across voice, chat, email, social media and messaging platforms.

The company provides customer acquisition, customer support, collections, retention and technical assistance services, along with digital solutions. Through its technology subsidiary, Omind Technologies, it develops artificial intelligence-powered tools for customer engagement, marketing, quality automation and workforce management.

Fusion CX serves clients across telecommunications, banking, financial services and insurance (BFSI), healthcare, retail and technology. As of March 31, 2026, the company had 13,357 employees engaged in its customer experience business operations.

2.headline: Upcoming IPO: SME issue of Kolkata-headquartered Ravita Engineering to open for subscription next week; check key details
2.heading: Upcoming IPO: SME issue of Kolkata-headquartered Ravita Engineering to open for subscription next week; check key details
2.intro: The company provides engineering, procurement, installation and commissioning services for heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems.
2.body:
Kolkata-headquartered Ravita Engineering Services will launch its maiden public issue worth Rs 116.05 crore on October 13, with the price band fixed at Rs 105-112 per share.

At the upper end of the price band, the company is valued at around Rs 422 crore.

The anchor book for institutional investors will open on October 12, while the SME issue will close on October 15. The share allotment is expected to be finalised by October 16, and the company’s shares are expected to be listed on the NSE Emerge platform on October 21.

Ravita Engineering Services provides engineering, procurement, installation and commissioning services for heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, central air-conditioning solutions, air-flow systems, chiller plants, industrial compressors, cooling equipment and other related electromechanical equipment on a turnkey basis for commercial and industrial establishments.

The company also provides operation and maintenance services.
Check All IPO News
According to platforms tracking grey market activity, the company’s shares are commanding a flat grey market premium (GMP) ahead of the IPO launch.

The company plans to use the proceeds from the issue to meet its long-term working capital requirements, purchase certain heavy equipment and fund general corporate purposes.
